## HISTORICAL RATE TRENDS  
### 12-Month Rate Trend (SmartSaver Tier 1)  
```
5.0% │                    ╱──
│                   ╱
4.5% │        ────────╱
│       ╱
4.0% │      ╱
│     ╱
3.5% │────
└─────────────────────
Jan   Apr   Jul   Oct   Dec
```  
**Trend:** Rates increased Q4 2025 due to BoE base rate increases  
**Forecast:** If BoE holds at 4.0%, FirstUK likely maintains rates through Q1 2026
